Dialog.name: MSG_000_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 3 1 3 0 -1 20302 0 0}{f 5 21 1 160}Huh? Did you actually get everyone's orders?[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MSG_003_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 3 1 3 0 -1 20305 0 0}{f 5 21 1 160}Oh, that's fine. Can't force you to help.[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MSG_012_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 5 21 1 160}Oh yeah, a drink for that monk upstairs. I bet he wants more brandy again.[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MSG_014_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 3 1 3 0 -1 20305 0 0}{f 5 21 1 160}Okay, I'll serve him a glass for you since you don't seem like a bad kid.[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MND_015_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}Looks like I've gained his trust... Now[n]I should be able to talk to the monk.[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MSG_016_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 5 21 1 160}Go ahead and let him know that his drink's coming up.[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MSG_019_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 3 1 3 0 -1 20304 0 0}{f 5 21 1 160}Oh, all right. Just let me know when he's ready to order.[n]{f 1 1}

Dialog.name: MSG_020_0_0
Dialog.Page: {f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 3 1 3 0 -1 20302 0 0}{f 5 21 1 160}Hey, what can I get for ya— Oh, it's you.[n]{f 1 1}
{f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 5 21 1 160}That monk's not here today. He doesn't usually come on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays.[n]{f 1 1}
{f 0 5 254}{f 2 1}{f 5 21 1 160}He must be busy holding services or something.[n]{f 1 1}
